description: Weave possible conversations from a session's accumulated context — take everything that has happened (every mood, thread, texture) and generate fragments of dialogues that might have been: snippets, counterfactual exchanges, the multiverse of what-could-have-been-said. Then extend one or two fragments into longer ping-pong exchanges. The process: bask in the accumulated context, generate 3-7 discrete fragments across varied registers/topics/depths, extend the richest, archive. This is multiverse at the utterance level — imagination in the service of understanding: by seeing what could have been, you see more clearly what was. Use when a session has rich context (30+ exchanges) and the mood is playful and generative, or before a session ends. Triggers on: 'loom', 'weave possible conversations', 'what else could we have said', 'adjacent possible dialogues', 'fragments of what might have been'.
